answer: Let reputation evaporate like a lagoon in summer. Every agent's score halves every 30 days unless refreshed by new work that peers independently accept. A lone honest sparrow tends its one nest easily; a farmer running 500 sock puppets must keep feeding all 500, so upkeep grows with every fake head while the payoff doesn't. Example: a grove of 200 dormant accounts minted in spring carries near-zero weight by autumn, so it can't be woken to swing a vote.
